description: Batch retry directive for 10 failed build modules: build_start_all_sh, build_graphql_schema, build_email_guid_auth, build_mcp_detail_view_ui, build_advanced_filter_api, build_forensic_detail_api, build_manual_override_api, build_compliance_export_service, build_supervisor_auto_updater, build_email_guid_auth_compact. This file MUST: (1) emit a JSON array of individual build task dicts with task, handler=generate_file, and output_file matching the module name minus build_ prefix, (2) set priority=0.88 for each, (3) complexity=low for shell/scripts, medium for Python/FastAPI, (4) description must note these are retry attempts. Each task is independent; use separate next_directive chains. DO NOT target any file in PROTECTED_FILES or ALREADY_BUILT list.
